note: The Lean and Mathlib communities certify that Alpöge's Lean library of about 17 million lines proves Mathlib's statement of the Riemann hypothesis, after independent builds, two statement-comparison tools and checks by several independent proof checkers. The certificate covers formal correctness; explaining the proof's new ideas is left to the wider mathematical community.
title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis
who: Lean and Mathlib communities (endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative)
